meta_description: Jasman Electrics Ltd in Leicester. Trusted local electrician for domestic and commercial work. Fast, reliable service. Call 07886 508266 today.
hero_subhead: From faulty sockets to full rewires—Jasman Electrics fixes it fast, safely, and at a fair price.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to planned installations, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with professionalism and care.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, faulty wiring, or dead outlets? We attend call-outs same day, diagnose the fault quickly, and get your power back on safely.

services.title: Full House Rewiring
services.desc: Old wiring posing a fire risk? We replace outdated circuits with modern, safe installations that meet current regulations and boost resale value.

services.title: Lighting Installation & Design
services.desc: From energy-efficient LEDs to decorative ceiling fixtures, we plan and install lighting that suits your space and cuts your bills.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Electrics
services.desc: Safely install sockets, extractor fans, and lighting in wet areas. Every installation meets Building Regs and includes full certification.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Fusebox Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old, dangerous fuseboxes with modern RCD-protected consumer units. Improves safety and unlocks capacity for new circuits.

services.title: Periodic Testing & Inspections
services.desc: Landlords and businesses: we test fixed wiring annually and issue certification. Protects tenants and keeps you compliant with law.

about_pullquote: I started Jasman Electrics because I wanted to be the electrician I'd want in my own home.
about_para_1: Jasman Electrics has been serving Leicester homes and businesses for over 18 years. We began as a one-man operation and have grown into a trusted team, handling everything from emergency repairs to full rewires without ever cutting corners. Every electrician is trained to current standards and carries the right credentials—because shortcuts cost lives.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, explaining the job clearly, and charging a fair price without hidden extras. Customers return to us because we treat their home with the same care we'd treat our own. Whether you need a single socket moved or your entire house rewired, we get it done right.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Jasman Electrics

reviews.text: Called Jasman on a Saturday morning with a complete power loss in the kitchen. He was at my door by 11am, found a dodgy connection in the consumer unit within 20 minutes, and had me safe and sorted by lunch. Top bloke, fair price, and very professional. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Derek T.

reviews.text: Had Jasman in to rewire the upstairs of our old Victorian terrace. The quote was honest, the lads were tidy and polite, and the certification arrived bang on time. Felt genuinely confident in the work from day one. Would use him again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: My landlord insisted on an electrical inspection—dreading the cost. Jasman's report was detailed and fair, and he only flagged one actual issue. Did the remedial work professionally and inexpensively. Honest tradesman. That's rare.
reviews.author: Michael J.
